rebaseline_2_3.decision: 2026-11-17 ODIN Dev: releases 2.3.0 and 2.3.1 run this workload slower than the 2026-10-31 measurements, on odin-ci (repetition time 15.5 s against 13.3 s typical, +16.5%; write p95 mean 680-685 ms against 629 ms, +8-9%) and on the Mac (10.5-11.0 s at 2.3.1 against a worst of 9.2 s), so it is the product and not the host; the cause is not found yet and is an open item (ODIN register D21). That used up the margin: the 2.3.1 hotfix validation (gha-44036780307-1) failed api_load by 0.7-3.4% while the VM's host was contended, although 2.3.0 and 2.3.1 measure the same side by side. The odin-ci write limit is the idle worst plus 15%, the method used before. The repetition time is NOT set by that method: it is the worst seen inside the failed gate run plus 8%, because the gate runs api_load after two hours of load and the idle figure does not show that. Tighten both again when the drift is explained. See docs/TRUSTED_VALIDATION_SCOPE.md 'api_load limits for 2.3'.

write_p95_ms.evidence: worst write p95 742.1 ms over 6 idle runs (18 repetitions) on odin-ci on 2026-11-17 09:20-09:38 UTC, alternating 2.3.0 (39dd3b8f: mean 680, worst 742) and 2.3.1 (1a183019: mean 685, worst 733); +14.9%. Inside gate run gha-44036780307-1 the worst was 781.3 ms

maximum_repetition_seconds.evidence: worst 17.54 s inside gate run gha-44036780307-1 (sar on odin-ci: steal about 1% in that window, 12% forty minutes earlier); +8.3%. Idle the same day: worst 15.96 s over the 18 repetitions (mean 15.5 s), so 19 s is +19% over the idle worst. This limit is not per host, so it also loosens the Mac's (10.5-11.0 s measured there at 2.3.1)

judging_2_4.author: 2026-11-19 ODIN Dev
judging_2_4.decision: Judge the upper median of the untraced read and write p95 values against their respective host limits. Cap each repetition at 1.15 times those limits. No limit value changed.
judging_2_4.evidence: On 2026-11-19, gha-44473325241-1 at d52c819a recorded write p95 values of 750.7, 735.7 and 863.6 ms against 853 ms. On odin-ci, sar recorded 2.0% and 0.9% steal around the 09:10-09:20 UTC window. This was the second gate failure from one repetition on a contended host in three days, after gha-44036780307-1. In three alternating rounds on the idle test machine at 09:25-09:43 UTC (nine repetitions per version), 2.3.1 at 1a183019 averaged 681 ms write p95 with a worst of 701 ms and 15.44 s per repetition. The candidate at d52c819a averaged 657 ms with a worst of 683 ms and 15.56 s per repetition.
